:::{#exr-sq-bias-expand}
#### Expanding the squared bias

Using @thm-bias-exprs,
expand the squared [bias](#def-bias) $\sqf{\bias{\hth}}$
in terms of $\E{\hth}$ and the estimand $\th$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-sq-bias-expand}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sqf{\bias{\hth}}
&= \sqf{\E{\hth} - \th}
&& \text{(bias equals expectation minus truth)}\\
&= \sqf{\E{\hth}} - 2\E{\hth}\th + \th^2
&& \text{(expand the binomial square)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
